# Höga förväntningar – experternas avgörande frågor

**Feed**: borslunch  
**Published**: 2026-10-13  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

EFN Börslunch (13 Oct 2026), with guests Katrin Danin (Söderbergs), Marie Giertz (Nordea) and Filip Ripman (Storebrand), discussed volatility in Korean semiconductor stocks, how much the AI and data-centre investment cycle is holding up global growth and earnings, rising real interest rates, the US midterm elections as a risk to data-centre build-out, and the latest IMF growth forecasts. The guests are cautiously positive on equities and on high-yield credit over Swedish mortgage bonds, though they see more risk ahead. Filip Ripman favours cybersecurity, renewables and grid/cable names such as Prismian and Nextracker as 'picks and shovels' for AI.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 AZN — AstraZeneca | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Cited analyst: Nordea upgraded to buy and raised its target price to SEK 1,900 from 1,650; shares +2.4%.

#### Reasoning

This is a cited analyst view (Nordea), not the hosts' or guests' opinion. The upgrade to buy and the roughly 15% higher target price imply upside from current levels over the analyst's 12-month horizon. The episode gave no further fundamental discussion.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Nordea or other analysts downgrade
- if the share price reaches the SEK 1,900 target
- if pipeline or earnings news disappoints

> *"De toppar OMX30 med en uppgång på 2,4% efter att Nordea höjt aktien till köp och höjt riktkursen till 1900 kronor från 1650 kronor."*

---

### 🟡 ALFA — Alfa Laval | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Cited analyst: BNP Paribas upgraded to neutral from underweight; stock near its all-time high around SEK 588.

#### Reasoning

BNP Paribas lifted its view from underweight to neutral, which is a hold rather than a buy call. The stock is about SEK 4 from an all-time high, so momentum is positive but the analyst sees limited further upside.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the stock fails to break its all-time high and reverses
- if Q3 orders disappoint

> *"de stiger efter att BNP Paribas uppgraderat sin rekommendation till neutral från undervikt"*

---

### 🟢 PRY — Prismian | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Guest Filip Ripman holds it; preferred over NKT and Nexans for its US manufacturing, digital cables and grid exposure.

#### Reasoning

Ripman (guest, Storebrand) argues that grid and cable build-out will be needed whatever happens with AI. Prismian has more business lines than its peers, US production and digital cables, which makes it a safer 'picks and shovels' play than speculative AI names. Power-grid constraints on data centres support demand.

#### Sell Triggers

- if grid/data-centre capex slows materially
- if US manufacturing advantage erodes
- if rising rates de-rate infrastructure names

> *"Så det är en viss trygghet i att vara i det segmentet, kanske bättre än något av dessa tokenbolag."*

---

### 🟢 NXT — Nextracker | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Ripman: reports have beaten expectations but the stock was sold down on rising rates; he sees this as sentiment and still finds it interesting.

#### Reasoning

The guest sees the renewables sell-off as rate-driven sentiment rather than a fundamental problem, since Nextracker has delivered solid reports over the years. Higher oil prices and supply disruptions should support demand for alternative energy, and the industry now has different expectations and valuations than in past cycles.

#### Sell Triggers

- if real interest rates keep rising
- if reports start missing expectations

> *"Långt förbi förväntningarna har levererat ganska bra rapporter genom åren men har tagits ner nu som ett resultat av att räntorna kommer upp."*

---

### 🟡 006400 — Samsung SDI | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Held by Ripman's fund; Korean battery exposure they still find interesting despite heavy Korean volatility.

#### Reasoning

The guest's fund holds Samsung SDI and remains positive on the segment despite Korea's swings. The Korean market is up about 79% this year in SEK, so the guests note it is volatile and prone to sharp moves.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Korean market volatility escalates further
- if battery demand weakens

> *"Ja, vi har Samsung SDI, bland annat. Batterier, kanske några subtex i Korea som vi fortfarande tycker är intressant."*
